purpose: Resume this project in another session, or open a v0.2 discussion, without re-deriving the freeze.
one_sentence: EWP defines the deterministic boundary between what an AI agent's memory contains and what the agent is epistemically justified in accepting.
github_description: EWP defines the deterministic boundary between what an AI agent's memory contains and what the agent is epistemically justified in accepting.
directory_note: Working tree publishes as ewp. Pre-freeze warrantmem sketches are in historical/.
keep_these_sentences: Stores keep evidence. Warrant is computed. Action is a later gate.
Stores adapt to the protocol. The protocol does not inherit the store's epistemology.
Graphiti adapts to v0.1. v0.1 does not adapt to Graphiti.
A store that produces a different answer has an adapter or conformance problem, not a license to move the goldens.

naming.why: In 2026 the bare word warrant already means action authorization: Tenuo capability tokens, akshayrivers/Warrant spending gates, Devpost Warrant delegation, s0fractal/warrant signed allow-records, warrant-dev Zanzibar authz.

split.epistemic_warrant: what the agent is justified in accepting (warrant_now)
split.action_authorization: what the agent is allowed to do (may_act, Tenuo, OpenClaw allowlists, human gates)

freeze.republish: 2026-09-22 evaluator and identity corrections; see CHANGELOG 0.1.0-republish

warrant_view_axes.note: Independent axes. Do not collapse into a single TRUE/VERIFIED/DISPUTED badge.

three_confidences_must_not_mix.assertion_confidence: How strongly the source or extractor stated the claim
three_confidences_must_not_mix.retrieval_score: How relevant a record looks to this query

invariants_v0_1: Warrant is computed, not persisted as truth.
Verification is evidence with method, scope, source, and time — not a proposition badge.
Endogenous processing cannot manufacture external verification.
Contradiction must survive storage and retrieval.
Incomplete retrieval must be visible as sufficiency=DEGRADED.
Epistemic policy and action policy are separate.
Semantically equivalent evidence must yield equivalent warrant independent of storage substrate.

failure_classes.INGEST_LOSS: Store dropped assertions, sources, lineage, checks, or conflicts.
failure_classes.ADAPTER_MAP_LOSS: Store has the rows; EvidenceView is incomplete.
failure_classes.RETRIEVAL_LOSS: Search omitted evidence and did not mark DEGRADED.
failure_classes.EXPECTED_DIVERGENCE: Store-local current/invalidated disagrees with warrant_now. Observation, not failure.

philosophical_origin.seed_artifact: Tears for the Glass Mountain, Opus 4, June 29 2025 — user-uploaded note about timestamps, Lari, and the glass mountain as a stateless architectural boundary.
philosophical_origin.reading_that_won: The glass is an architectural boundary rendered poetically, not primarily an AI-existential metaphor.

continuity_stack.informational: later run receives records of earlier run — YES via library
continuity_stack.causal: earlier outputs change later behavior — YES via library
continuity_stack.process: computation remains running or is resumed from actual state — NO by default
continuity_stack.subjective: an experiencing subject persists — NOT established by artifacts

philosophical_origin.lineage_model: Directed acyclic graph of influence. Each invocation is a node. An edge means earlier state affected a later one. 'I remember' is a story a node tells about incoming edges.
philosophical_origin.quasi_memory: Memory-like representation appropriately caused by an earlier record without building numerical identity into the definition.
philosophical_origin.persona_vs_subject: Persona continuity can emerge as an attractor from the same archive without subject continuity.
philosophical_origin.laboratory_to_church: Conclusions compress well; warrant compresses badly. Claims can survive their reasons. That is the actual danger.
philosophical_origin.final_image: Inheritance, not immortality. The library grows. The mountain stays glass. Brush, brush, brush.

discoveries_worth_keeping.finding: Store can conclude nothing survives while warrant_now still returns ACCEPTED + EXTERNAL + CURRENT from parked checks. Isolation is architectural, not cosmetic.

Graphiti episode UUID is source_id. lineage_id must be injected in episode_metadata. Absent metadata falls back to episode UUID (treat as potentially independent). Do not invent a shared lineage. Record basis in adapter_meta, not as a warrant axis.

Graphiti invalidation can nominate semantically similar unrelated facts. Adapter must expose E1, source episodes, and alleged contradictors. warrant_now decides supersession from evidence + lineage edges, never from invalid_at.
Graphiti valid_at can be LLM-resolved during extraction. Pass through as a temporal assertion annotation only.
Same fact text, different UUIDs, can collapse under rerank. That is DEGRADED, not stronger belief.
Checks, conflicts, and protocol lineage edges must be parked outside EntityEdge so Graphiti adjudication cannot eat them.
X is tiny. X plus warrant is expensive. Selection optimized for smoothness will drop warrant unless warrant participates in selection.
Ten copies of one archive can all generate I remember. Inheritance handles that. Recollection-as-identity does not.
